name: Tabrico – PDF Catalog for WooCommerce
author: ootlstudio

sections.description:
Tabrico turns your WooCommerce products into a printable PDF catalog or price list, laid out automatically.

  1. Go to Products › PDF catalog and click Open Tabrico.
  2. Tabrico opens in a new tab with your products and the prices your shop displays: tax included or excluded as your shop shows them, each variation on its own line, sale prices while a sale runs.
  3. Choose all your products, a category or some products, a layout (price list, catalog with photos, or one product per page) and a design.
  4. Download your PDF.

Prices are never recomputed or rounded by Tabrico: each printed price is the one WooCommerce displays on the product page.

Free and paid

The plugin is free. Tabrico makes the PDF on its servers (tabrico.com):

  • the free version prints the first 10 lines, with a note at the bottom of the pages;
  • a paid catalog prints all lines (up to 500) without the note: 19 € up to 100 lines, 39 € up to 500 lines;
  • a one-year pass gives unlimited catalogs for your shop, up to 500 lines each, without the note: 49 €, paid once, no automatic renewal.

Payment is made on tabrico.com with Stripe. No account is needed before paying.

External services

This plugin connects to Tabrico (https://tabrico.com), the service that lays out and makes your PDF. It is needed: the plugin itself does not make PDFs.

  • When: only when you click Open Tabrico on the Products › PDF catalog page, and while you work in the Tabrico tab that opens. Nothing is sent when the plugin is activated, or on any other page.
  • What is sent: your shop’s name and currency, whether it displays prices with taxes, its product categories, and the products you work with in Tabrico: names, short descriptions, prices, SKUs, barcodes (GTIN, EAN…), brands, categories, variation attributes and image addresses. Also a random key created by the plugin, which identifies your shop to Tabrico (to attach a one-year pass to it), the plugin’s version and your admin language.
  • What is not sent: no customer, order, user or account data, and no WordPress login.
  • Payment: if you buy a catalog or a pass, you pay on a Stripe page opened by Tabrico; Stripe receives your payment details and email.

Tabrico’s terms: https://tabrico.com/conditions (English: https://tabrico.com/en/conditions)
Tabrico’s privacy policy: https://tabrico.com/confidentialite (English: https://tabrico.com/en/confidentialite)
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install the plugin from Plugins › Add New, or upload its folder to /wp-content/plugins/, then activate it.
  3. Go to Products › PDF catalog.

Your browser must allow this site to open a new tab (pop-ups). Keep the PDF catalog page open while you work in Tabrico: it passes your products to Tabrico.
sections.faq:
Which prices are printed?

The prices your shop displays to a visitor on the product page, at your shop’s default customer location: tax included or excluded according to WooCommerce › Settings › Tax › “Display prices in the shop”, sale prices while a sale runs, and each variation’s own price. In Tabrico you can also print the prices the other way (tax excluded instead of included, or the reverse), as WooCommerce computes them.

Which products are included?

Published products shown in your shop’s catalog, with their variations offered on the product page. Hidden products, drafts and grouped products (their own products are listed on their own) are left out.

Which currencies are supported?

Euro, US dollar, pound sterling and Swiss franc.

Why does Tabrico open in a new tab?

Tabrico is an online service. It opens in its own tab, and this page passes your products to it.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin removes its only setting, the key that identifies your shop to Tabrico. A one-year pass is attached to that key: reinstalling the plugin creates a new key.
